cascadeDeltas.change: Added attachReviewRoutes/handleReviewHttpRequest/startReviewControlServer for bearer-only loopback review API.
Product-owned review HTML shell with restrictive CSP and no token-in-URL.
Safe textContent renderers for reviews, files, diff hunks, and threads.
Keyboard file movement and fetch client; no localStorage review truth.
Documented durable review browser surface and coordinator hook.
Noted /reviews loopback API beside session serve.

requirementChanges.change: session-control-server.ts left untouched. Coordinator should call handleReviewHttpRequest before other routes, or attachReviewRoutes on a dedicated server.
